timing: Windows thread cycles on logical CPU 2; three warmups, separate untimed allocation probe, seven batches per process, four alternating processes per version. Host workloads/frequency are uncontrolled.
original_limitations: Three iterations per batch made short reader measurements sensitive to noise. The generic 16-bit gather showed no benefit, and scalar first-row Average regressed. These implementations were refined rather than selected.
reader_fingerprint: Fingerprint of the input PNG file; every decoded image is independently compared with the generated native image before timing.
encoder_fingerprint: Fingerprint of independently modeled complete filtered pass bytes. Both encoders are checked through independent flate2 inflation and native image decoding before timing.
refinements: Keep whole-pixel 8-bit gathers, remove the generic 16-bit gather kernels, and reconstruct first rows with constant shifts and register-carried pixel lanes. Unused zero-predictor clearing is removed from the streaming path.
final_refinement: Reuse existing Sub reconstruction and retain scalar recurrence for two-byte first rows; register lanes remain for other Paeth/Average strides.
